name: fiken-ai-monorepo
description: Fiken AI monorepo with MCP server

scripts.build: cd fiken-shared && npm run build && cd ../fiken-mcp && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: cd fiken-shared && npm install && npm run build && cd ../fiken-mcp && npm install
scripts.logs:problems: railway logs -p a9f5c6a8-193e-470b-b5b2-ee8c2f4a9e17 -e e2886363-3125-4b3d-911a-a2b00e6cc51d -s fiken-mcp -f '@level:error OR @level:warn'
scripts.logs:tools: railway logs -p a9f5c6a8-193e-470b-b5b2-ee8c2f4a9e17 -e e2886363-3125-4b3d-911a-a2b00e6cc51d -s fiken-mcp -f '"Tool call"'
